* Support FyerX in establishing new client relationships through professional introductions, client discussions, and staffing partnership opportunities.

* Build and maintain an active network of qualified IT professionals for immediate and upcoming staffing requirements.
* Monitor recruitment market trends, technology hiring demands, compensation expectations, and candidate availability.
* Ensure timely communication with candidates, clients, recruitment partners, and internal stakeholders.
* Meet assigned recruitment delivery, candidate submission, interview, closure, and client partnership targets.
* Maintain professionalism, confidentiality, and ethical standards when handling candidate information, client relationships, and recruitment activities.

  
  

### **Requirements**

* Strong recruitment experience across enterprise technologies such as ServiceNow, SAP, Salesforce, Data & AI, Cloud, DevOps, Java, .NET, Python, and Full Stack Development.

* Advanced sourcing experience using Naukri Resdex, LinkedIn, job portals, Boolean searches, professional referrals, and recruitment databases.

* Familiarity with Zoho Recruit, ATS platforms, vendor management systems (VMS), CRM tools, and recruitment trackers.

* Good understanding of IT staffing commercial models, candidate compensation, contract rates, notice periods, and recruitment delivery processes.

* Ability to independently manage multiple technical requirements, prioritize urgent positions, and consistently meet recruitment delivery timelines.

* Strong ownership, professionalism, confidentiality, and the ability to work effectively in a remote environment.

  
  

### **Benefits**

If you have strong experience in IT recruitment, a proven record of successful placements, and established professional relationships within the IT staffing industry, we encourage you to apply for the **IT Recruiter** role at FyerX.

**General Information:**

**Job Title:** Senior Consultant - Manhattan WMi (iSeries / AS400)

**Primary Job Location**: Hybrid, Bengaluru based, or Remote within India

**Employment Type**: Full-time employment

**Hiring Timeline**: Immediate

**Reporting Line**: Co-Founder, COO & SVP Enterprise Systems

**Application Deadline**: Open until filled

**About Fulfillment IQ (FIQ)**

Fulfillment IQ is a supply chain engineering and transformation company that helps brands, retailers, and 3PLs design, build, and scale high-performance logistics operations.

We work at the intersection of strategy, supply chain, and technology where we solve complex, real-world problems across warehouse design, automation, order management, transportation, and end-to-end supply chain execution.

Our teams combine deep domain expertise with strong technical capability, delivering outcomes through consulting, systems implementation, and proprietary platforms that accelerate time-to-value and reduce delivery risk.

If you enjoy working in complex environments, partnering closely with clients, and seeing your work make a tangible impact on how global commerce moves, this is the place where your skills and judgment truly come to life.

**Role Overview**

This role supports FIQ client engagements where the warehouse runs on an IBM i (iSeries / AS/400) WMS, such as Manhattan WMi (PkMS), Blue Yonder (JDA) WMS on IBM i, or a comparable legacy platform. The primary focus is WMS data: getting accurate, timely data out of DB2 and into the hands of operations, reporting, and leadership teams, then supporting the integrations and system changes that depend on it.

You'll work with distribution and fulfillment clients across manufacturing, retail, and 3PL, alongside client configuration and operations leads, BI developers, and FIQ's onshore and offshore delivery teams. This is a techno-functional seat: strong SQL and data skills come first, backed by enough warehouse process knowledge to know what the data means. Depending on the engagement, the work extends into WCS, LMS, ERP, and MHE integration, testing and go-live support, and helping clients modernize, whether that means moving to a modern data platform or migrating from a legacy WMS to a cloud WMS.

**Mandate**

* Extract, transform, and deliver WMS data from DB2 on iSeries to BI and reporting platforms
* Own the WMS data model on each engagement: table structures, relationships, and field definitions
* Turn operational questions into accurate, repeatable queries and data feeds
* Support WMS integrations with WCS, LMS, ERP, TMS, and MHE, including data mapping and testing
* Help clients move from ad hoc data pulls toward governed, scalable reporting and modern data platforms

**Must-Have Qualifications**

* Technical: 5+ years as a technical or techno-functional analyst on a WMS running on IBM iSeries (AS/400), such as Manhattan WMi, JDA/Blue Yonder WMS on iSeries, or similar
* Technical: advanced DB2 for i SQL skills, including complex joins, performance tuning, and extracting large data sets quickly and reliably
* Technical: experience building data extracts, views, or pipelines that feed BI and reporting tools (Cognos, Power BI, Tableau, or similar)
* Technical: working knowledge of WMS integrations with WCS, LMS, ERP, TMS, or MHE, including flat file, socket-based, and API-based interfaces
* Functional: solid understanding of warehouse processes (receiving, inventory, replenishment, wave planning and release, picking, packing, shipping) and how they are represented in WMS data
* Functional: experience with data validation and reconciliation, and supporting testing (unit, SIT, UAT) for data and integration changes
* Ways of working: able to ramp quickly in a new client environment, handle high volumes of data requests, and collaborate with onshore and offshore teams
* Travel: able to travel 20-30% to client sites as needed
* Language: professional working proficiency in English, written and spoken

**Nice to Have:**

* RPG, CL, or COBOL experience on IBM i
* Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Snowflake, or other modern data platforms
* Data migration experience from legacy iSeries WMS to cloud WMS (for example, Manhattan Active WM)
* Python or other scripting for data automation
* Manufacturing, retail, or 3PL distribution experience

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Data Extraction and Modeling**

* Write and optimize DB2 SQL to extract inventory, order, wave, labor, and shipping data from iSeries WMS platforms
* Build repeatable extracts, views, and scheduled data feeds for BI developers and analysts
* Document WMS data models, key tables, and field definitions so reporting can scale

**Reporting and Analytics Enablement**

* Partner with BI developers to design data sets that support operational dashboards and KPIs
* Respond to ad hoc data requests from operations and leadership with accurate, timely answers
* Validate and reconcile reporting outputs against source WMS data

**Integration Support**

* Map WMS integration touchpoints, message formats, and data flows with WCS, LMS, ERP, TMS, and MHE
* Troubleshoot integration and data issues, and support changes during system migrations
* Support data movement into modern platforms (for example, Microsoft Fabric) as client roadmaps evolve

**Testing and Knowledge Transfer**

* Write test scenarios and run data validation for SIT and UAT
* Provide on-site support during cutovers and stabilization as needed
* Document queries, integrations, and fixes, and coach client and offshore team members

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Turnaround time on data extraction and ad hoc query requests
* Dashboards and reports live on reliable WMS data within the first 60 days of an engagement
* Data accuracy and reconciliation rate between WMS source and reporting outputs
* Integration and data defects found and resolved before go-live
* Client satisfaction and engagement extensions

**Why You Will Love Working Here**

At Fulfillment IQ, we do not just build supply chain solutions, we build long-term careers. We give our people real ownership, real influence, and meaningful responsibility. Whether you are leading a client relationship, shaping a solution, or building internal capability, your decisions have visible impact. **An overview of this role**
----------------------------

As a Staff Software Engineer on GitLab's Authentication team, you'll be the technical lead for how every user, application, token, and automated agent proves who it is on GitLab.com, Self-Managed, and Dedicated.

We're an OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC) provider for millions of users. We also accept identity from enterprise identity providers through Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML) and Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP). Behind that sit more than ten token types and several session methods that grew inside the Ruby on Rails monolith. You'll help us move this work onto GATE, GitLab's new authentication and authorization platform. GATE exchanges external credentials for short-lived tokens at the edge through a Secure Token Service written in Go.You'll set our technical direction, lead the hardest protocol and migration work yourself, and help senior engineers own the rest.

Our projects include:

* **OAuth across Cells:** Making OAuth clients, grants, and tokens work when users and organizations live in different cells
* **Global identities:** One user identity that works across organizations and cells
* **Token consolidation:** Reducing the number of token types and moving token issuance and validation out of the monolith
* **Identity for artificial intelligence (AI) agents and workloads:** OAuth for Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients, workload identity federation, and service identities with narrow scopes

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own the technical direction for authentication protocols at GitLab, including OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, and token exchange, across the Rails monolith and GATE services.
* Write and drive design documents and architecture decision records (ADRs) for multi-quarter work, then break that work into increments that ship behind feature flags.
* Lead migrations that must not break existing customers: token formats, client and grant state, and session behavior on GitLab.com, Self-Managed, and Dedicated.
* Be hands-on in the most complex parts of the code, in Ruby on Rails and Go, and review the designs and merge requests of other engineers.
* Agree interface contracts with the GATE Core, GATE Infra, Authorization, and Tenant Scale (Cells and Organizations) teams, and keep them current as the architecture changes.
* Treat authentication as a security and availability boundary: threat-model new flows, add rate limits and abuse controls, and lead the technical response to authentication incidents.
* Mentor senior and intermediate engineers on the team and raise the protocol and security knowledge of the whole group.
* Work asynchronously with engineers in India, Europe, and the Americas, with most decisions made in writing.
* Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* Significant experience building and running production authentication or identity systems at scale, with technical leadership across teams that moves unclear problems to written decisions and shipped code.
* Deep, hands-on knowledge of OAuth 2.0 and OIDC: authorization code with Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE), refresh token rotation, token exchange, client registration, scopes, and JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) with signing keys and key rotation.
* Working knowledge of SAML 2.0 single sign-on and enterprise identity integration (LDAP, System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM), or similar).
* Strong production experience in Ruby on Rails or Go, willingness to work in both, and experience with careful refactors, feature-flagged rollouts, and backward-compatible migrations in large, long-lived codebases.
* A security mindset. You think about token theft, replay, revocation, and blast radius before you think about elegance.
* Experience with multi-tenant software as a service (SaaS) systems, including data isolation and performance under high request volume.
* Clear, concise written English and comfort working in an all-remote, asynchronous company.
* Optional experience: authentication libraries (Doorkeeper, Devise, or OmniAuth), passkeys or multi-factor authentication, workload identity, gateways or policy engines, AI agent authentication, or multi-region architectures. Contributions to identity standards or open source identity projects are also welcome.

**About the team**
------------------

The Authentication group is part of the Security Platform stage, alongside Authorization, GATE Core, GATE Infra, Secrets Manager, and other security teams. We own sign-in, single sign-on, OAuth, and personal and service tokens. Our work touches every GitLab customer, and much of it is on the critical path for Cells and for GitLab's AI agent platform.

### **A****BOUT TIDE**

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.

### **ABOUT THE ROLE**

The Tide Security Engineering team is made up of three core areas: Product Security, Identity, Threat Detection & Response

**Product Security** consists of application and cloud security experts. Their mission is to protect the products we build, covering everything from secure design reviews to threat modelling and penetration testing, ensuring security is embedded from the ground up.

**Threat Detection & Response** (this role!) focuses on protecting the company by building a robust detection and automation platform. We're proactive in our defence, constantly hacking ourselves to improve our security posture and staying ahead of emerging threats. Our goal is to make Tide resilient against the ever-evolving threat landscape.

**Identity** is responsible for managing Tide's staff identity platform, ensuring that access to systems and infrastructure is secure, seamless, and aligned with modern security practices. The team uses strategies like zero trust, multi-factor authentication, and granular role-based access controls to safeguard our internal operations.

While each area has its own focus, collaboration is key - it's why we share the same Slack channel and hold our standups together as one cohesive team, ensuring alignment and seamless communication across all security functions.

As a Security Operations Responder, you'll be on the front line of defending Tide. Your primary focus is actively investigating threats through our security data lake and SOAR platform – but we don't want anyone working the same alert by hand twice. Your goal is to make investigation effective at scale: cutting manual effort through automation, and working hand-in-hand with our Detection Engineering team to improve the true positive / false positive efficacy of what lands in the queue.

When the security queue is empty, you'll be building – automations, enrichment and your own detections. An open mind and a curious approach are key: every investigation is a chance to make the next one faster and sharper.

**As a Security Operations Responder, you'll be:**

*Investigating and responding to threats (your primary focus)*

* Actively triaging and investigating security alerts and threats through our security data lake and SOAR platform, across AWS, GCP, SaaS (such as Google Workspace and Okta), internal applications and employee endpoints (Windows, macOS).
* Driving every investigation to a clear, well-evidenced outcome – establishing scope, impact and root cause, and taking containment and remediation actions quickly and confidently.
* Leading the response to complex or high-severity incidents where needed, coordinating across security, IT and engineering teams through containment, remediation and recovery.
* Documenting investigations clearly and consistently, and contributing to the runbooks and investigation standards the whole team works to.

*Scaling investigation through automation & Improving detection efficacy*

* Reducing manual investigation by building SOAR playbooks, security automations and services – from data enrichment and context gathering through to automated response, such as removing phishing emails from employee mailboxes. We want you to run with the "anything is possible" mantra.
* Spotting repetitive work in the queue and turning it into automated workflows, so the team's time goes on the investigations that genuinely need human judgement.
* Identifying gaps in log sources, parsing and enrichment in the data lake, and working to close them so investigations have the visibility they need.
* Feeding investigation outcomes back to the Detection Engineering team – flagging noisy rules, tuning false positives and highlighting coverage gaps – to continuously improve TP/FP efficacy.
* Tracking investigation metrics (such as MTTD, MTTR, TP/FP rate and automation coverage) and using them to prioritise where to improve next.

*Building when the queue is clear*

* Writing, testing and shipping your own detections alongside Detection Engineering, following our test-driven, detections-as-code practices.
* Proactively hunting for sophisticated threats across our infrastructure, using threat intelligence and lessons from past investigations to stay ahead of attackers.
* Building or enhancing internal tools that streamline investigation, improve data visibility and increase response efficiency.
* Sharing knowledge and mentoring other members of the team, raising the bar for how we investigate and respond.

### **WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* Significant hands-on experience in security operations, incident response or threat investigation, ideally in a cloud-native environment.
* Strong investigative instincts and log analysis skills at scale, with the ability to query a security data lake or SIEM fluently – strong knowledge of one of the following: Splunk, Scanner, Sentinel, SecOps.
* Strong understanding of modern attack and defence techniques which apply to Cloud (AWS, GCP), SaaS (such as Google Workspace and Okta) and desktop (Windows and macOS) environments, and the ability to map activity to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.
* Strong experience in security automation, from writing scripts (e.g. Python) to creating end-to-end automated workflows. Familiarity with SOAR platforms and automating investigation and response tasks.
* Experience writing or tuning detections, and a clear view of what separates a high-fidelity alert from a noisy one.
* Calm, methodical judgement during live incidents, including knowing when and how to escalate.
* An open mind and a curious approach – you enjoy pulling on threads, and you don't stop at "false positives" without understanding why.
* Hands-on attitude and the ability to drive solutions to completion.
* Passion for passing on knowledge to fellow colleagues.
* Excellent spoken and written communication skills, including clear investigation write-ups for both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Bonus points if you have a repository showcasing automations, detections or tooling you've built.

### **WHAT YOU'LL GET IN RETURN**

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:

* **Competitive Compensation –** competitive salary.
* **Time Off –** Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
* **Parental Leave –** Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
* **Sabbatical –** Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
* **Health Insurance –** Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top-up options.
* **Life & Accident Cover –** Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
* **Mental Wellbeing –** Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.

We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. * Compile, format and consolidate proposal documents in accordance with company templates and client instructions.
* Support final compliance checks, confirming that forms, declarations, attachments and supporting documents are complete.

* **U.S. Staffing Operations**

The Principal Technical Consultant (Forward Deployed Engineer) for AI Security is a senior, customer-facing technical leader responsible for deploying, integrating, and operationalizing AI security capabilities in real-world customer and enterprise environments, with a focus on securing AI systems, LLM applications, and agentic workflows. This role works at the intersection of engineering, AI, security, data, and customer success to translate complex requirements into scalable, production-ready solutions.

This individual partners closely with security leaders, AI engineers, data scientists, platform teams, and infrastructure stakeholders to implement AI security controls, secure AI development pipelines, integrate security tooling for AI systems, and accelerate time to value. **Customer and Stakeholder Delivery**

* Serve as the senior technical lead for deploying and operationalizing AI security solutions in customer or enterprise environments

* Design and implement integrations across AI platforms, model registries, LLM gateways, vector databases, and AI-enabled security tooling

* Integrate APIs, webhooks, message queues, and automation workflows across AI operations, identity, cloud, and application ecosystems supporting AI systems
* Develop reusable deployment patterns, templates, and technical assets to accelerate future AI security implementations

**AI Security Operations**

* Operationalize security controls and guardrails for AI systems, including prompt injection defense, model access controls, data leakage prevention, and agentic workflow monitoring
* Secure non-human identities (NHI), including service accounts, API keys, tokens, and autonomous agent credentials, across AI and agentic workflows
* Work with AI, detection engineering, and data teams to implement red teaming, adversarial testing, model risk scoring, and anomaly detection for AI systems
* Help define data requirements, feedback loops, and operational guardrails needed to secure AI systems in production environments
* Ensure deployed solutions are practical, measurable, and aligned to AI governance and risk objectives

**Automation and Reliability**

* Implement secure and governed automation for AI security monitoring, investigation, and response use cases across heterogeneous environments
* Support resiliency, observability, performance, and scale requirements for deployed AI security solutions
* Troubleshoot integration issues, deployment blockers, and production challenges in partnership with AI, platform, cloud, and security teams
* Improve reliability and maintainability through documentation, testing, monitoring, and standardized engineering practices

**Cross-Functional Teaming**

* Work cross-team collaboration across AI Engineering, Security Engineering, Data Science, Infrastructure, Sales, and product or customer teams
* Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including executive audiences
* Mentor and develop engineers and consultants, contributing to best practices for AI security implementation, delivery, and technical solution design
* Provide field feedback to influence platform roadmap, product direction, and architectural standards
* Support the practice in pre-sales activities, proposal development, and client presentations

* 10+ years of experience in security engineering, AI engineering, platform engineering, forward deployed engineering, solutions consulting, or related technical roles, with demonstrated progression to a principal or senior consulting level
* Hands-on experience securing AI systems, LLM applications, or AI production pipelines
* Experience deploying cloud-native architectures on at least one major cloud provider such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Strong background in data integration, telemetry pipelines, normalization, and security analytics workflows applied to AI systems
* Experience working directly with customers, executive stakeholders, or cross-functional delivery teams in implementation-focused environments
* Proven experience developing technical proposals, statements of work, and scoping documents for customer engagements
* Ability to lead technical engagements, drive execution, and influence outcomes without direct authority
* Demonstrated ability to enable cross-team collaboration across engineering, security, data science, and business stakeholders

### **Technical Skills**

* Strong understanding of AI security risks, including prompt injection, model theft, data poisoning, adversarial attacks, and agentic AI risks, alongside foundational cloud, identity, and endpoint security
* Experience with scripting and automation using tools such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash
* Familiarity with APIs and integration patterns including REST, webhooks, and event-driven workflows
* Working knowledge of AI concepts including LLMs, vector search, retrieval-augmented generation, model evaluation, and AI assistants or agents
* Strong problem-solving skills, execution mindset, and ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-moving environments

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with implementation and integration of OpenAI models, specifically Daybreak Blue and/or Red.
* Experience with implementation and integration of Anthropic models.
* Experience with AI red teaming, adversarial AI testing, or AI governance frameworks such as the NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, or the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications

You treat ambiguity as an invitation to bring clarity, not as a reason to slow down. Stepping into complex, high-stakes moments with a steady presence comes naturally to you. You listen carefully for what's unsaid, ask the questions that unlock momentum, and align people around the real problem, not just the loudest symptom. When something breaks, curiosity and methodical thinking guide you as you trace causes with patience while keeping the bigger picture in view.

Constantly looking for leverage is part of who you are. Patterns reveal themselves to you, one-off fixes become repeatable playbooks, and you leave behind cleaner processes than you found. Precision balanced with pragmatism helps you know when to go deep and when to move forward with a well-framed assumption. * Enhance customer satisfaction and loyalty through expert support, proactive problem-solving, and training that builds internal capability

The role is responsible for supporting Accounts Payable (AP) and Travel & Expense (T&E) operations, including transaction processing, accounting activities in SAP, and ensuring timely payments across HARMAN entities globally. The position will involve working closely with Finance leaders and business stakeholders to ensure accurate accounting, timely transaction processing, and effective period-end closing activities in line with business requirements. Additionally, the role will support the Finance Manager in managing day-to-day operations, process execution, and coordination of the Accounts Payable and Corporate Travel & Expense functions.

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Process vendor invoices, ensure accurate accounting entries, appropriate approvals, and compliance with company policies and procedures.

* Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing activities, including accruals, account reconciliations, and financial reporting.
* Review employee expense claims, manage Travel & Expense (T&E) accounting, ensure correct tax treatment (GST, TDS, VAT, WHT), and identify non-compliant transactions.
* Ensure adherence to internal financial controls, company policies, and SOX/ICFR requirements while coordinating with Finance, Controlling, FP&A, Tax, Procurement, and business teams.

* Previous experience working in a Shared Services or BPO environment.

* This role is based in Bangalore, India, and follows a hybrid work model with regular in-office collaboration with Corporate Finance, Controlling, Tax, and FP&A teams.

**Company:** Paramount Overseas Consultants  
**Location:** Bangalore, India  
**Experience:** 7–12 Years

**Industry:** Overseas Education & International Admissions

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced, dynamic and target-driven Head of Sales & Business Development to lead and scale our overseas education business.

The candidate will be responsible for building B2C and B2B client networks, driving student acquisitions, developing institutional and channel partnerships, managing the sales and admissions teams, and owning the complete sales conversion lifecycle.

The role also requires the ability to guide the digital marketing team, develop effective lead generation strategies and leverage technology to drive business growth.

Key Responsibilities

**1. B2C Sales & Student Acquisition**

* Develop strategies to acquire students directly across India and international markets.
* Drive student counselling, client acquisition and conversions across UG, PG, MBA, MBBS and other international education programmes.
* Manage the complete sales journey from initial enquiry to paid enrolment.
* Build referral networks through students, parents and alumni.

**2. B2B Business Development**

* Build partnerships with schools, colleges, educational consultants, agents and institutional partners.
* Identify, negotiate and onboard new channel partners across domestic and international markets.
* Develop commercial partnerships and drive consistent student referrals and conversions.
* Build and maintain long-term business relationships.

**3. End-to-End Sales & Admissions Conversion**

* Own the complete sales funnel from lead generation, qualification and counselling to application, offer acceptance and final enrolment.
* Ensure effective coordination between sales, admissions, visa and operations teams.
* Monitor lead follow-ups, conversion ratios and revenue performance.
* Establish structured sales processes and ensure CRM discipline.

**4. Team Management & Leadership**

* Recruit, train and manage sales executives, counsellors and business development teams.
* Set individual and team targets and monitor performance.
* Conduct regular sales reviews and implement performance improvement plans.
* Build a result-oriented sales culture with clear accountability.

**5. Digital Marketing & Lead Generation**

* Guide and provide strategic direction to the digital marketing team.
* Have a strong understanding of Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO, social media and performance marketing.
* Drive digital lead generation strategies aligned with business targets.
* Monitor campaign performance, lead quality, cost per lead and conversion rates.
* Work with the digital team to improve marketing ROI and student acquisition.

**6. AI, Technology & Business Growth**

* Explore AI-powered tools and automation to improve lead management, student engagement and sales conversions.
* Identify opportunities to streamline business operations through technology.
* Use CRM platforms such as Zoho, HubSpot or Salesforce for pipeline management and reporting.
* Identify new markets, courses and revenue opportunities.

Candidate Requirements

* 7–12 years of experience in sales and business development.
* Minimum 3–5 years in a leadership or managerial role.
* Experience in overseas education, international admissions or student recruitment preferred.
* Proven ability to build B2C and B2B business channels.
* Strong negotiation, networking and client acquisition skills.
* Good understanding of digital marketing and performance-driven lead generation.
* Experience in managing sales teams and achieving revenue targets.
* Strong CRM, reporting and analytical skills.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* AI tools and automation experience will be an added advantage.

Key Performance Expectations (KPIs)

* Monthly and quarterly revenue achievement.
* Number of direct B2C student conversions.
* Number of active B2B partnerships and student conversions.
* Lead-to-client and client-to-enrolment conversion ratios.
* Digital marketing lead quality and acquisition cost.
* Sales team productivity and target achievement.
* Overall business growth and profitability.

First 90-Day Expectations

* Assess existing sales processes, teams, lead pipelines and conversion gaps.
* Develop and implement B2C and B2B growth strategies.
* Establish new channel partnerships and improve direct student acquisition.
* Align digital marketing campaigns with sales objectives.
* Introduce structured reporting, CRM discipline and measurable sales targets.
* Present a six-month business growth and revenue plan.

**What We Are Looking For**

A business-minded sales leader who can independently build revenue channels, acquire clients, establish strategic partnerships, guide digital marketing, lead teams and take complete ownership of end-to-end business conversions.

**The expectation: Build the network, generate the leads, convert the clients, lead the team and deliver revenue.**

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
